item.title: UniQure Huntington's Gene Therapy
item.description:
• Summary: UniQure filed for UK approval of its Huntington's disease gene therapy, AMT-130, after a dispute with the FDA over data and trial design. The company is seeking marketing authorization in the UK while addressing regulatory concerns.
  • MoAs: AMT-130: AAV5-based gene therapy delivering a microRNA to suppress mutant huntingtin expression (RNA interference).
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, BioSpace

item.title: Alector/GSK Alzheimer's Failure
item.description:
• Summary: Alector and GSK's Alzheimer's antibody failed a Phase 2 trial, marking the third neurological failure for Alector. The anti-CD33 antibody did not meet endpoints, casting doubt on the mechanism and the $700M partnership.
  • MoAs: Anti-CD33 antibody: targets CD33 on microglia to modulate neuroinflammation and amyloid clearance.
  • Sources: BioSpace, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Indivior Phase 2 Failure
item.description:
• Summary: Indivior reported a Phase 2 failure for an undisclosed drug, with the company expecting significant impact on its R&D team. The drug was likely intended for substance use disorder.
  • MoAs: Not disclosed.
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Hinge Migraine Device
item.description:
• Summary: Hinge Health received FDA clearance for a new device designed to treat migraines. The device uses neuromodulation to provide relief, offering a non-pharmacological option for patients suffering from migraine headaches.
  • MoAs: Neuromodulation (likely electrical stimulation) to alleviate migraine symptoms.
  • Sources: STAT News
